description: Ukraine on Monday hosts a meeting of its key European backers to press for air-defence supplies and more pressure on Moscow, with Russian attacks killing more civilians than at any time since the first months of the invasion. The meeting of the Coalition of the Willing will be jointly chaired by the leaders of Britain, France and Germany. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

title: EU, Russian aircraft help Serbia battle wildfires
description: EU crews and a Russian aircraft help Serbia fight major wildfires as extreme heat fuels fires across the Balkans.

title: The right to health in Gaza is now a privilege
description: The devastated healthcare system cannot reach Gaza’s most vulnerable – those who live in displacement camps

title: Ukraine’s allies convene in Kyiv as Zelenskyy seeks air defence boost
description: Coalition of the Willing leaders to discuss air defence shortage as Ukraine and Russia trade drone attacks.

title: Pakistan’s army chief back in Iran: Can he break peace talks deadlock?
description: Pakistan says it can offer a channel between Tehran and Washington, but analysts differ over how much influence it has.

title: How much more are you spending on petrol since the war in Iran began?
description: At least 145 countries have reported increases in petrol prices since the attacks on Iran by the US and Israel began.

title: Запасы газа в подземных хранилищах Европы заполнены на 61,68%
description: Запасы газа в подземных хранилищах Европы по итогам газовых суток 22 августа снизились до 61,68%, сообщает ассоциация европейских операторов газовой инфраструктуры Gas Infrastructure Europe (GIE).

title: Ceferin won’t challenge Infantino for FIFA presidency but tells him to quit
description: European football chief doesnt want to lose credibility over FIFA job but says Infantino will face a challenger.

description: Pakistan says it can offer a channel between Tehran and Washington, but analysts differ over how much influence it has.

title: China probes use of formaldehyde to keep cabbages fresh
description: Using the carcinogen to preserve food is prohibited in China, the world's largest producer of cabbages.

title: Ligue 1: Ferran Torres saves Paris Saint-Germain against Rennes
description: Paris Saint-Germain snatched a draw away at Rennes (2-2) on the opening day of Ligue 1. Ferran Torres, Paris’s new signing, came on after the break and saved the day for PSG.

title: French MEP Glucksmann seeks to unite the left in bid for French presidency
description: Centre-left politician Raphaël Glucksmann on Sunday launched his bid for the French presidency, aiming to unite moderate left-wing voters and challenge far-left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon ahead of France’s 2027 election. With Marine Le Pen leading first-round polls, Glucksmann is seeking to position himself as a pro-European, pro-Ukraine alternative to both the far right and hard left.

title: UEFA chief Ceferin calls for Infantino to quit, but 'not interested' in replacing him
description: Aleksander Ceferin, president of the European soccer confederation (UEFA) has announced that he will not run against Gianni Infantino but warned the under-fire FIFA president that he must either quit or face a leadership challenge in March. Infantino has been mired in a crisis since the failure of his controversial – and ultimately abandoned – plan to open FIFA to private investors.
